kind.description: `alias_call` for a transaction that calls `0x2::address_alias`, `signer_change` when it also carries a composition note.

ready.description: True when one of the acting signer sets in signerSets has reached its threshold. Counted against the sets that act now, also for a proposal that is no longer pending, except a signer change; executedVia names what executed it. A pending signer change also needs the signatures of the new signer set for its own threshold.

signatures.description: One entry per key that signed.

signerSets.description: The signer sets that act for the account on the proposal's network, now, also for a proposal that is no longer pending; executedVia names what executed it. For a signer change, only the set it replaces: while pending, only while that set acts; once no longer pending, as the change describes it, still flagged acting, since it is the set the proposal was counted against. Then the original set, with acting false, when it is not among them.

executedVia.description: The address that signed for the account when the proposal was executed, recorded when it is verified. Null until then, or when it could not be read.

signerSetsStale.description: True when the alias set could not be read from the chain, so the signer sets are as last read.

currentWeight.description: The summed weight of the members that signed; 0 for a set that does not act.

acting.description: True when the set acts for the account on the proposal's network. For a signer change, true for the set it replaces, the one the proposal is counted against, also once it is no longer pending. False only for the original set when it is listed only so the account's address can be rebuilt: once it was removed there, or beside the set a signer change replaces. A set that does not act counts no signatures.

original.description: True for the original set. A convenience: the original set is the one whose members and threshold make up the account's address, so check the address.

removes.description: The signer set the change removes. Null when its composition note does not check; such a change is never ready.

adds.description: The signer set the change adds. Null for a change that only removes.

labels.description: The account’s labels for the keys the added set brings in, in its order: only the API’s word, for display.

ProposalSignerChange.description: The API’s reading of the signer change in the transaction bytes, which is only its word: a client reads and checks the bytes itself with the SDK (`checkSignerChange`).

proposer.description: The proposer's newest add or remove.

cancelled.description: The proposal's newest `proposal.cancelled` event: who cancelled it and when. A cancel by a proposer removal carries a `caused_by` proof naming the removal's event.

ProposalEvents.description: The proposal's audit log events, for checking who proposed it and who cancelled it. Each is null where none exists.

proof.description: The signed proof as stored; older rows can hold older shapes.

AccountEvent.description: An account audit log event, as stored.

transactionBytes.description: The transaction, fully resolved, as base64 BCS bytes.

signature.description: The proposer's signature over the transaction.

labels.description: For a signer change that adds a signer set: what the account calls each of its keys, in the order of the composition note. Only keys new to the account are labelled.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `nextCursor` for the next page. Null when the page is empty.

signerSets.description: One entry per signer set: first the original set, the one at the account's address, then the others in the alias set on the request's network.

signerSetsStale.description: True when the alias set could not be read from the chain, so the signer sets are as last read.

acting.description: True when the set is in the alias set on the request's network; false only for the original set once it was removed there.

original.description: True for the original set. A convenience: the original set is the one whose members and threshold make up the account's address, so check the address.

kind.description: An address in the alias set that the API cannot identify. It can sign for the account.

label.description: The account's label for the key.

KeyAnswer.description: A key's answer for the account; `invited` until it answers.

transactionDigest.description: The signer change that removed the set, as the API names it, or null when it names none; a client reads the transaction from its own node.

RemovedAccount.description: An account one of the caller's keys was removed from on the network.

signerSets.description: One entry per signer set: first the original set, the one at the account's address, then the others in the alias set on the request's network.

signerSetsStale.description: True when the alias set could not be read from the chain, so the signer sets are as last read.

signerChangesEnabled.description: Whether signer changes are enabled for the account on the network.

networksWithDifferentSigners.description: The other supported networks whose alias set differs from this one.

signerChanges.description: The signer changes that succeeded on the network, oldest first, as the API lists them; a client reads each transaction from its own node.

openSignerChange.description: The pending signer change on the network, or null, as the API reports it; a client reads the transaction from its own node.

event.description: The proposer's newest add or remove, or null.

removed.description: Whether this call removed the proposer from the list.

cancelledProposals.description: The digests of the pending proposals this call cancelled.

AccountProposerRemoval.description: What this call did. A request whose signature is already recorded does nothing.

post.description: Signed over the transaction by an accepted key of an acting signer set, or by a proposer of the account. A member’s signature counts as its first vote. Only one proposal that calls `0x2::address_alias` per account and network is pending at a time. A signer change, recognised by its composition note, is checked against the account’s signers on the network, and the signer set it adds is written.

400.description: The request, transaction or signature is invalid, the network is not supported, or a signer change does not check.

403.description: The signer may not propose for the account on the network, the address is not an account, or the proposer of a signer change is not an accepted signer of the set it replaces who stays.

503.description: The signers of the account on the network could not be checked, or the account is busy.
